title: WL-MT401-WpLocalStoreAuthorityExceptionGate
clause: Resolve the no-SQLite authority conflict before any Turso-backed implementation and either authorize a narrow governance-only evaluation lane or reject the candidate without product-code adoption.

branch_contract.approved_for_evaluation: MT-402..409 may execute in dependency order under the exact signed exception; MT-410 then runs comparative production-boundary evaluation.
branch_contract.rejected: MT-402..408 must not execute or change product code and receive validator-checked NOT_APPLICABLE_BY_MT401_REJECTION dispositions. MT-409 executes only its no-code structured rejection projection, then MT-410 closes with REJECT plus independent proof that no Turso dependency, file or runtime path exists.
branch_contract.no_implicit_approval: A missing, stale, unsigned, ambiguous or over-broad exception selects the rejected branch.

scope.summary: GOAL: Decide whether Handshake may evaluate a Turso-backed WP-local working store without weakening SurrealDB/EventLedger authority. Current CX-503N/CX-503R/CX-503S and the Tailor and Studio SurrealDB overrides prohibit SQLite-family caches, adapters, fixtures and proof paths. No Turso crate, file, schema, broker or runtime path may be implemented until an operator-approved, versioned exception explicitly permits only a governance-local, non-authoritative, feature-gated evaluation. SurrealDB/EventLedger remains the sole main authority across managed projects. A missing, denied or ambiguous exception produces a durable REJECT decision and blocks MT-402 onward from implementation mode.
forbidden_paths: Any Turso/libSQL/SQLite implementation before a signed exception
Any change that demotes SurrealDB/EventLedger authority
acceptance_criteria: The authority inventory cites the exact current no-SQLite clauses, including CX-503N/CX-503R/CX-503S, TAI-SDB-002, STU-SDB-002 and STU-OVR-003, and identifies every acceptance tripwire that a WP-local engine would otherwise violate.

A versioned operator-approved exception either exists or the candidate is rejected. An allowed exception is limited to governance-local WpLocalStore evaluation, declares storage_authority=CONDITIONAL_NON_AUTHORITY_ONLY, and cannot authorize product/domain authority, fallback, cache equivalence, fixtures-as-proof, cloud sync or dual writes.
The exception states that Notes, Loom, CKC/Atelier, Tailor, Studio and canonical Locus records never enter the WP-local store; their modules cannot depend on or directly open its engine or files.

The evaluation is feature-gated and default-off. A denied, missing, unsigned, stale or broader-than-requested exception fails closed before dependency resolution, database creation or runtime initialization.

The decision artifact records APPROVED_FOR_EVALUATION or REJECTED, authority version/hash, operator signature reference, exact allowed data classes, exact forbidden data classes, expiry/review posture and the MTs enabled by the result.
No source, Cargo, fixture or runtime file changes occur in this MT; independent diff proof confirms that the gate did not smuggle implementation into an authority decision.
proof_targets: Validate the authority inventory against the current SPEC_CURRENT bundle and Handshake_Codex_v1.4.md by exact clause ID and content hash.
Run a negative contract test showing MT-402 implementation mode refuses missing, unsigned, expired and over-broad exceptions before any filesystem or dependency side effect.
Inspect the repository diff and dependency graph to prove no Turso/libSQL/SQLite source, Cargo feature, fixture, database file or runtime initialization was added by MT-401.
Retain a machine-readable hsk.wp_local_store_exception_decision@1 verdict with one of APPROVED_FOR_EVALUATION or REJECTED.
expected_tests: Authority-clause hash and ID verification passes against current files.
Missing or invalid exception returns WP_LOCAL_STORE_AUTHORITY_EXCEPTION_REQUIRED and creates no file.
Over-broad exception permitting canonical content, cloud sync or module-local caches is rejected.
Repository dependency and file scans remain free of new Turso/libSQL/SQLite implementation artifacts.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Authority decision only; MT-409 owns the eventual diagnostic surface if evaluation proceeds. A structured TraceProjection must still expose the verdict and blocker code.

target_entries: WP-local working store > Evaluation authority and non-authority boundary

same_project_private_resource_cases: The exception never grants access to a same-project resource beyond the principal's existing ResourceGrant.
cross_account_negative_cases: A principal cannot use the exception, project_id or wp_id to open another account's project resources.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: The capability grant and decision artifact preserve the intersection of source scopes and add no content access.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Revocation, project switch or AccessSpace switch invalidates evaluation access and leaves no local residue on rejection.
remote_saas_mcp_sync_cases: The exception authorizes no remote SaaS, MCP, Turso Cloud, replica or sync access.
metadata_side_channel_cases: Decision artifacts expose no secrets, tokens, encryption keys, sensitive paths or unauthorized resource existence.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: The exception verdict and authority hashes must be attributable and replayable without becoming a product mutation.
Blocked evaluation must expose exact conflicting clause IDs and a stable reason code.
This MT starts no background job or process.

risk_if_missed: Implementing before the exception would knowingly violate current authority, introduce a hidden SQLite-family dependency, and make every downstream proof invalid.

risks: An exception is worded broadly enough to legalize a second authority or product cache.
A dependency or empty database file is added before the gate and dismissed as harmless scaffolding.
Tailor or Studio no-SQLite clauses are ignored because the store is described as governance infrastructure.
A rejected decision is treated as permission to continue provider-neutral implementation that already embeds engine assumptions.
minimum_controls: Exact clause inventory and signed versioned decision before code.
Default-off fail-closed gate with no side effects.
Explicit allowlist and domain-content denylist in the exception.
Independent diff and dependency inspection before MT-402 is unblocked.

official_sources.title: Turso SDKs
official_sources.finding: The official matrix distinguishes the turso Rust crate for local embedded use from legacy/remote libSQL paths; this supports evaluating only the local crate and rejecting cloud/legacy modes.

official_sources.title: SurrealDB Rust SDK
official_sources.finding: The official SDK supports typed local or remote authority access, authentication and live queries; it remains Handshake's main authority client.

official_sources.title: SurrealDB permissions and row-level security
official_sources.finding: Table permissions default to NONE for record users and must remain part of canonical privacy proof.

research_provenance.selected_approach: Authority-first go/no-go gate; only a narrowly signed governance-local evaluation can proceed, while SurrealDB/EventLedger remains sole authority.
rejected_options: Implicit exception by calling Turso a cache
